safari.closeCompletelyInstructions: Close Safari completely (swipe up then swipe app away), then reopen from home screen.
safari.installDescription: Add C-Mngt to your home screen for quick access and offline use

ios.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari toolbar
ios.step2: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'

mac.step2: Select 'Add to Dock' from the menu
mac.step3: The app will be added to your Dock for easy access
